verdict.rationale: Puzzle explicitly supports natural-language interaction: users can 'ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English' (docs-9), use 'ask AI' for categorization (docs-25), run Accounting AI prompts over the ledger (docs-30), and connect via MCP to Claude for 'natural conversation' with financial data (docs-22/33). These are concrete, varied NL command surfaces beyond marketing copy. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of NL command accuracy or reliability, and detail on the breadth of commands supported beyond examples given
